sources.label: Morphe patches for streaming and news phone apps: skip ads, block tracking, and
sources.author: Mobile
patch_list: Stops the app's analytics, ad measurement, and marketing services.
Hides the bottom tabs you choose in the options. Home always stays.
Removes Ask Scout and its announcement, the AI key takeaways on stories, and the AI comment summaries.
Videos play only when you tap them, and video rails and image carousels do not move on their own.
Signs in with Google through GmsCore instead of Google Play services.
Removes the rating request, the notification prompts, and the feature tooltips.
Removes the reading streak and level from Home and Profile, and the pop-ups that celebrate them.
Turns on features Yahoo has not released to everyone. Choose them in the options.
Removes the ads in the news feeds, in articles, and before videos.
